verdict.rationale: IRCC's own site points to a sanctioned representative rail: it has a representatives account area and a way to check whether a representative is authorized. The evidence is only navigation-level link text, though. Nothing shows how a representative is designated, what they can do on a company's or employer's behalf, or how authorization works. missing for 10: documentation of how representatives are appointed and authorized to act for an employer, scope of delegated actions, detail on the authorized-provider registry, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company

citations.quote: Check if your representative is authorized, report fraud or abuse
